name: Flowsery
tagline: Turns session recordings into a ranked list of things to fix
description: If you run a site on Flowsery, this pulls out what its analysis already spotted while watching real visitors: the outright bugs, the flows that dead-end, and the interface friction that made people stumble. Everything comes back ordered by how many visitors actually hit it.
author: tarasshyn
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
